cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: It stores Berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.description: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.description: Once wrapped around its prey, it never lets go. It eats the prey by tearing at it with sharp fangs.

cards.name: Burmy
cards.description: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Binacle
cards.description: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

cards.name: Barbaracle
cards.description: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something only Gothita can see.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.description: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.description: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.description: A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.description: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.description: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.description: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.description: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.description: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Servine
cards.description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.description: This vicious Pokémon is said to have flown in ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.description: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.description: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.description: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor–or like an earthquake has struck.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
